name: Zendesk Ticket Triage
summary: Classify incoming Zendesk support tickets by urgency and team, draft replies for simple ones, and escalate VIP tickets.

items.title: Incoming Zendesk tickets
items.description: Reads new incoming tickets from Zendesk as they arrive.
items.proved_when: New tickets appear in the system feed from Zendesk

items.title: Ticket classifier and router
items.description: Categorizes tickets by urgency level and assigns them to the correct internal team.
items.proved_when: Tickets are automatically tagged with urgency and team

items.title: Simple reply drafter
items.description: Generates draft responses for straightforward support tickets.
items.proved_when: A draft reply is generated and attached to simple tickets
items.source_quote: draft a reply for simple ones

items.title: VIP ticket escalator
items.description: Identifies high-value customers and flags their tickets for immediate escalation.
items.proved_when: Tickets from VIP customers are marked as urgent and highlighted for managers

items.title: Triage dashboard
items.description: Shows all processed tickets, their classification, draft status, and VIP escalations.
items.proved_when: Users can view a list of tickets with urgency, assigned team, and drafts
items.source_quote: Classify incoming Zendesk tickets by urgency and team

questions.text: How should VIP customers be identified?
